newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Valora spins off vending machine unit.
newsitem.headline: Valora spins off vending machine unit.

text.p: Swiss retailer, caterer and bedding maker Valora Holding AG said it would spin off its vending machine unit Selecta.
"A public share issue is in the foreground in making Selecta autonomous," it said in a statement, adding it would release details in February 1997.
The division is Europe's market leader and has 620 million Swiss francs in annual sales in seven countries, it said.

"A thorough analysis of Selecta's development possibilities found that this is an outstanding time to make it independent and that it makes new earnings potential possible. Such a step also makes important cooperation (accords) easier in this sector," it said in a statement.
